All seven deliverable files are in place with no truncation, temporary harness files removed.

## Done — 3D office building simulation

Built all seven files per spec, in the mandated load order:

| File | Role |
|------|------|
| `index.html` | Exact shell: Three.js 0.128 + OrbitControls from CDN, scripts in order |
| `person.js` | `createPerson()` factory (hip/shoulder-pivoted limbs, +Z nose, color palettes) + `animatePersonWalking()` |
| `world.js` | Building shell (four-strip slabs around the shaft hole, front entrance gap on floor 0 only), per-floor offices/conference/lounge, full lobby (cafe, lounges, pit, reception, kiosk, coolers, loiter spots), BFS nav graph, `sitTargets`, canvas call panels |
| `elevator_logic.js` | Pure SCAN scheduler/state machine (5 states), anti-starvation rules, capacity & logical spots, Node-compatible export |
| `elevator.js` | Yellow car, sliding doors, destination buttons, in-car indicator; thin adapter delegating all scheduling to `ElevatorLogic` |
| `sim.js` | Sim clock, 10-keyframe day/night, 20 workers + 80 recycled visitors, primitive-action plan compilers, lockstep render loop, soft collisions, HUD |
| `elevator_logic_test.js` | 7 deterministic Node tests |

### Verification
- **`node elevator_logic_test.js` → 7/7 PASS** (lobby rush, dest-outranks-hall-call, no starvation, opposite-dir waits, door hold/safety cap, destination preserved through handshake, reset).
- **Headless Chrome (real WebGL), full simulated day, zero runtime errors.** Occupancy ramps to the target (45) by ~11 AM and holds; conference rooms stay busy (IN_MEETING peaks at 9); lunch surge ~1–2 PM; evening exodus drains 45→0 by ~7:40 PM with down-calls on occupied floors; day-wrap resets the car with **0 phantom passengers**.
- **Seated orientation: 19/19 sitting agents face their seat correctly** (no one sitting backwards — legs toward desk/table).
- Screenshot confirmed transparent geometry, the yellow car in the shaft, furnished floors, and a populated lobby.

### Two bugs caught and fixed during the verification pass
1. **Agents never spawned** — `spawnAgent` left state at `AWAY` while the dispatcher `return`ed early, so agents re-spawned in place every frame instead of running their plan. Fixed by transitioning to `ARRIVING` on spawn and falling through to dispatch.
2. **Momentary stacking on disembark** — multiple riders snapping to the same `elevWait` node in one frame. Added a small ring jitter on the disembark landing (collision resolver was already separating them the next frame, but this prevents the transient overlap).

Open `index.html` in a browser to watch it run at 120× (≈5.5 real minutes per workday); the speed and occupancy sliders are live.
